Fintech NerdCon emerged from a simple observation

Fintech NerdCon emerged from a simple observation

Fintech Nerds crave community. They’d often rather hang out in the lobby than the show floor because they want to be around each other. In 2025, we launched Fintech NerdCon in a big way and are back in 2026 in San Diego!


We've created a space where product managers can experience regulation firsthand, engineers can debate architecture with peers, and risk professionals can pressure-test their frameworks.


Our content council brings together leading operators who've built, scaled, and sometimes failed at the industry's biggest challenges. They ensure every session delivers practical value you can implement. But bringing that element of fun and community that seems like an after thought in every other conference and event.
